## Lab 3

## Exercise 1

```{r}
func_1 <- function (x){
  cat("The largest value in that vector of",
      length(x),
      "number is",
      max(x),
      ".")
}
func_1(c(1,2,3,5,7))

func_1(c(1,2,5,5))
```

## Exercise 2

```{r}
leap_year <- function(year) {
  if(year %% 400 == 0){
    TRUE
  } else if(year %% 100 == 0){
    FALSE
  } else if(year %% 4 == 0){
    TRUE
  } else{
    FALSE
  }
}
leap_year(2025)
leap_year(2024)
leap_year(2100)
leap_year(2000)
```
